title: TERRA: Terrain-Aware Reconstruction, Retargeting and Control for Musculoskeletal Locomotion
abstract: arXiv:2609.38653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in musculoskeletal modeling and reinforcement learning have enabled muscle-actuated agents to reproduce increasingly complex human motions. Yet these capabilities remain largely confined to flat ground, in part because motion datasets rarely include aligned terrain geometry and because retargeting terrain interactions to complex musculoskeletal bodies is challenging. We present TERRA, an end-to-end pipeline for terrain-aware retargeting and control of musculoskeletal locomotion. From kinematic trajectories alone, TERRA combines terrain priors, estimated contacts, and negative free-space evidence to recover task-relevant support geometry. TERRA further considers anatomical, tendon-continuity, and contact constraints during retargeting. translated_title: TERRA：面向肌肉骨骼运动的地形感知重建、重定向与控制
translated_abstract: 肌肉骨骼建模与强化学习的最新进展，使得肌肉驱动的智能体能够复现日益复杂的人体动作。然而，这些能力在很大程度上仍局限于平坦地面，部分原因是运动数据集很少包含对齐的地形几何信息，而且将地形交互重定向到复杂的肌肉骨骼身体上具有挑战性。我们提出了TERRA，一个用于地形感知的肌肉骨骼运动重定向与控制的端到端流水线。仅从运动学轨迹出发，TERRA结合地形先验、估计的接触以及负自由空间证据来恢复与任务相关的支撑几何结构。TERRA在重定向过程中还考虑了解剖学、肌腱连续性和接触约束。利用从五个数据集得到的运动-地形配对数据，我们成功地在9.4小时的多样化运动上训练出了一个单一的肌肉驱动控制策略。
tldr: TERRA提出了一个端到端的地形感知流水线，仅从运动学轨迹即可恢复支撑地形几何并考虑解剖学与接触约束进行重定向，从而首次实现了在多样化地形上训练单一肌肉驱动的运动控制策略。
en_tdlr: TERRA presents an end-to-end terrain-aware pipeline that recovers support geometry from kinematic trajectories alone and retargets motion with anatomical, tendon-continuity, and contact constraints, enabling a single muscle-actuated control policy for locomotion on diverse terrains.
